item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's teacher asks the class to find evidence that a gas produced during an experiment is carbon dioxide and that a chemical change has occurred.

Which observation is the best evidence for carbon dioxide causing a chemical change?

options.A: Bubbles escape when Rohan opens a bottle of soda water in the school canteen
options.B: Air blown through a straw into lime water turns the lime water milky
options.C: Water in a pan left on a hot stove slowly evaporates
options.D: A glass of cold water forms droplets on its outer surface on a humid day
